claims: Publix stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Publix pharmacies are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Publix liquor stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Publix closes for only three holidays per year—Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.
Publix will resume regular operating hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
